entries: You mean it is your specialty.
斩杀怪物才是我们的专长。
That is exactly what I've been saying all along.
我一直在说的就是这个。
You do well. Scaphin home take Scaphin further from humans. This good for both.
你们做得很好。斯卡芬的新家会让斯卡芬离人类更远。这对双方都好。
Welcome to visit. See humans are not enemy now.
欢迎来作客。看，如今人类不是敌人。
Relying on each other is not weakness, but strength.
彼此依靠不是软弱，而是力量。
I was hoping to learn more from your people...
我本希望能向你的族人多学些东西……
Not enough prove worth by smash. Take more to make king.
光会砸还不够证明价值。要更多，才能当国王。
We have cleared your home of Manshrooms.
我们已把人菇从你们的家园清除。
We don't know that for sure, but it is a start. We have weathered these challenges so far.
我们无法肯定，但这是个开始。迄今为止的挑战，我们都挺过来了。
Take heart friend. We will not abandon you.
振作，朋友。我们不会抛下你。
Good fortune. Success be with you. Coorou!
祝好运。愿成功相随。咕罗！
I believe that we will prevail.
I have found this group to be resilient. I am not afraid.
我发现这支队伍很有韧性。我不害怕。
人菇没了。算证明价值了吗？
Essence of dark lord still here. Not end of fight. Scaphin not like rely on humans, but must.
黑暗领主的精粹还在这里。战斗没有结束。斯卡芬，不喜欢依赖人类，但必须。
It is clear that this fight will not end until we defeat all of these monsters.
很显然，除非消灭所有这些怪物，这场战斗不会结束。
